title: Countersign: Transaction-Bound Agent Payments with Whitechain, World and ENSv2
description: Systems-security implementation case study giving Whitechain settlement, World sandbox authentication and ENSv2 identity/delegation equal analytical attention. Transaction-bound agent and owner signatures connect these distinct trust boundaries. The 22-page local revision includes 25 references, eight vector figures, recorded testnet evidence and reproducible local tests. A fresh 157-test Node checkpoint is separate from historical 109/154-test checkpoints and 131 Solidity executions including repetition. Gas results are four single-sample local mock-token observations, not public-network benchmarks. ENS fork execution and browser acceptance remain incomplete; two historical acceptance runs remain 5/6 each. No new cryptographic primitive, independent audit, production personhood or network performance superiority is claimed.
